name: Album Club Mune Kyun Saint Paulia Jogakuin
original_name: アルバム倶楽部 胸キュン セントポーリア女学院
source:
You've managed to go undercover as a photographer at a renowned boarding school for girls.
Take as many photos as you want of the prettiest girls and compile your ideal album!

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030212052725/http://www.societa.co.jp:80/AC_TOP.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
你成功以摄影师的身份，潜入了一所知名的寄宿女校。
尽情拍摄那些最漂亮的女孩，编成自己理想中的相册吧！

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030212052725/http://www.societa.co.jp:80/AC_TOP.html]official website[/url]]
